sentences.text: Revenue for Q2 FY2027 was $96.22 billion, up 17.9% from $81.62 billion in Q1 FY2027 and up 105.85% from $46.74 billion in Q2 FY2026.
Gross margin was 74.98%, compared to 74.93% in the prior quarter and 72.42% in Q2 FY2026, while operating margin reached 66.24%.
EPS (GAAP, diluted) for Q2 FY2027 was $2.46 per share, versus $2.39 per share in Q1 FY2027 and $1.08 per share in Q2 FY2026.
Operating cash flow for Q2 FY2027 was $24.08 billion, versus $50.34 billion in Q1 FY2027 and $15.37 billion in Q2 FY2026.
